thread:
Priya (sales): FYI Avalon asked for a 28-day POC. They want hosted API keys for devs, a small Dedicated pool, VPC peering, and a billing project with spend cap + starter credits. Can we get this live by next Wed?
Omar (billing): We can usually do hosted keys same day. For spend cap & credits I need org_id, billing contact, requested cap, and requested credits. Also indicate if they need a hard-stop enforcement.
Priya (sales): Org id is avalon-corp-01, billing contact billing@avalon.ai. They asked for $6,000 spend cap and $2,000 starter credits. Hard stop preferred.
Ivy (solutions): What traffic do they expect? We should size Dedicated pool accordingly. If it's light chat (15 rps avg, spikes to 35) a 1-node a10g-equivalent pool with auto-burst should suffice. Lock model family to 13B-quantized to avoid cost surprises.
Ben (infra): For peering we need their VPC CIDR, peer CIDR, list of allowed egress IPs, and whether they want private DNS. Peering turnaround is ~48 hours after we get the CIDR + signed AUP.
Priya (sales): I'll get the CIDR and confirm DNS. Legal asked about logs retention and CMEK. They want logs retention 14 days and CMEK if possible.
Legal Bot: CMEK requires KMS ARN and a security review (usually 5 business days). For hard stop on spend cap we need a signed POC addendum. I'll attach the template if you want.
Omar (billing): To provision the billing project, paste this payload into the provisioning form or send it to me: 
```
org_id: avalon-corp-01
billing_email: billing@avalon.ai
spend_cap_usd: 6000
starter_credits_usd: 2000
allowed_models: "13b-quantized"
quota_tokens_per_day: 600000
quota_rpm: 250
regions: "us-west-2,eu-west-1"
hard_stop: true
kms_arn: <optional_kms_arn>
logs_retention_days: 14
```
Omar (billing): I can enable hard-stop once Legal confirms addendum signed. Otherwise I'll set alert thresholds at 60/80/95% and a soft cap.
Ivy (solutions): Routing suggestion: preferred dedicated pool, fallback to hosted small-models only. Also add a canary route for evals to avoid 70B.
Ben (infra): If they choose CMEK, send KMS ARN and we mark the ticket for security review. Also confirm whether they want private peering or VPN. Private peering preferred.
Priya (sales): I'll upload signed addendum and CIDR by EOD. ETA for keys + provisional project after Omar runs the payload?
Omar (billing): Once I have payload + signed addendum, hosted keys + project created same day (usually within hours). Dedicated pool provisioning requires infra work and peering; estimate 48-72 hours after all infra inputs are in.
DevEx Bot: Quick CLI example to create a temp project for dev use: 
```
redwoodctl project create --org avalon-corp-01 --name="avalon-poc-temp" --spend-cap=6000 --credits=2000 --models="13b-q" --quota-tokens=600000 --quota-rpm=250 --regions="us-west-2,eu-west-1"
redwoodctl keys issue --project <id> --type ephemeral --ttl 7d
```
DevEx Bot: Ephemeral keys are safer for onboarding. Use scoped keys for engineer roles.
Omar (billing): Created ticket #POC-3147 to track billing & provisioning. I'll post project_id here once done.
Priya (sales): Thanks everyone  I'll drop the addendum and CIDR shortly. :thumbsup:
Ben (infra): Noted. I'll stand by for peering details and will pre-approve the subnet ranges to speed up turnaround.
